column4: Extreme close-up of the same porcelain maid doll's eye, identical crop and camera to the drowsy eye reference, now the eyelid pulled open by two taut fine golden marionette threads attached at the lash anchors. The orange iris and pupil clearly reflect a tiny but unmistakable full leaded cathedral icon window with the same girl inside, arms low and open, the reflected icon is already inside the pupil, not floating over the eye. Preserve exact eye identity, porcelain seam, orange hair edge shapes and lash locations; sharp clean shapes suitable for a hard cut from the half-closed eye.

A full-length alternative servant version of the exact same porcelain maid doll, preserving her face, orange hair and signature flower ornament: slender orange pointed petals with ivory center on coal bow and ivory ribbon tails. Front three-quarter standing pose, hands relaxed at her sides, both ball-jointed shoulders, elbows, hips and knees clearly visible, both wrist rings visible, exactly two arms and two legs, five fingers on each visible hand. Outfit is a simple tidy servant dress variant with apron, against a flat ivory background. Her winding key protrudes straight out of her back; seen from behind its bow is edge-on, a thin vertical line. Keep silhouette isolated, full body within frame.

A full-length icon-window version of the exact same porcelain maid doll, preserving her face, orange hair and signature flower ornament: slender orange pointed petals with ivory center on coal bow and ivory ribbon tails. She wears a solemn ceremonial long dress with simple halo-like leaded window geometry behind her, arms low and gently open, palms visible, front three-quarter view, exact same doll body with spherical joints and wrist rings, exactly two arms and two legs and five fingers on each visible hand. The winding key protrudes straight out of her back; seen from behind its bow is edge-on, a thin vertical line. Flat ivory background, full figure fully in frame, window geometry does not cover or become a flower halo.

A medium close-up of the same porcelain maid doll standing before a receding row of narrow cathedral dressing mirrors, exact established mirror bay and camera, her head facing forward, expression still and restrained, torso and shoulders visible, flower on the correct side, a taut fine golden thread attached to her head indicates puppet control. Her wind-up key protrudes straight out of her back; seen from behind its bow is edge-on, a thin vertical line. Lock the camera and composition with the tallest mirror clearly visible toward frame right, leaving space around her head for a later turn toward that mirror. No lettering.

A medium view in the established cathedral mirror bay: the same porcelain maid doll seen from behind and three-quarter side on the left, facing a single tall mirror on the right; in the mirror reflection is the exact same doll body and face looking back at her, aligned convincingly to the reflective plane. Mirror frame and lead details are crisp, both figures share matching size and perspective, mirror surface pale ivory. Her wind-up key protrudes straight out of her back; seen from behind its bow is edge-on, a thin vertical line. Keep the external doll pose still, arms down, reflection pose identical as a clean base state for later reflection-only changes. No text.
